claims.statement: Equality fusion gives a canonical coarser polynomial right factor, unique up to affine change.

Up to affine equivalence and lower-rank intersections, every complex polynomial P with q(P,dx)<=3 belongs to the power, Dickson, quadratic-over-power, cubic-over-power, indecomposable-quartic, or degree-twelve quartic-collision families listed in Theorem 11.1.
